device.manufacturer_model: Example laptop / example dock; exact identifiers not supplied
device.os_firmware: Windows build unknown; dock firmware unknown

complaint.desired_outcome: Determine why a call drops after the laptop sleeps.
complaint.observable_symptom: Owner reports Ethernet is unavailable after wake through the dock; Wi-Fi works.
complaint.triggering_conditions: Wake after at least 20 minutes asleep, dock connected

hazards: No heat, swelling or physical damage reported; absence not independently inspected
custody.backup_state: Reported cloud copy; recovery not tested
stop_or_referral: Stop if symptoms indicate device damage or required organizational authority

evidence.claim: Wi-Fi works during the same symptom

hypotheses.mechanism: Dock Ethernet adapter fails to resume
hypotheses.prediction: Adapter/link state differs after sleep but upstream router remains reachable over Wi-Fi

hypotheses.mechanism: Lease or interface configuration is lost after wake
hypotheses.prediction: Adapter remains present while addressing or gateway reachability changes

tests.action: Ask owner for exact adapter presence/link/address observations before and after one safe sleep/wake
tests.expected_discriminator: Absent adapter/link favors resume branch; present link with missing addressing favors configuration branch
tests.stop_condition: No disruptive reset or firmware work

verification.reopen_condition: Record exact device/OS identifiers and before/after adapter/link/address state; original envelope has not been retested.

next_move.action: Capture the smallest same-moment before/after network observations
next_move.evidence_to_advance: Adapter presence, link and address state during the reported trigger
